title: AI build preflight
summary: Check an AI-built app before publishing.
body:
Goal: catch obvious breakages before this AI-built app goes public.

Do:
1. Install clean and run the start command; confirm it boots.
2. Click the primary happy path end to end.
3. Secrets: no keys/tokens committed; .env ignored.
4. Check licenses on new deps.
5. Confirm README install steps work on a fresh copy.

Produce: a short PASS/FAIL list, one line of evidence each.
Stop when: every item has a verdict.
Record: the verdict list as the run receipt.
